name: Jeju (toddler, snow, cafes & food)
notes:
Flights: SIN 02:30 Sun 27 Dec -> CJU 09:30; CJU 19:45 Wed 30 Dec -> SIN 01:15 Thu 31 Dec. Hotel: Best Western Jeju Hotel, 27 Doryeong-ro, Nohyeong-dong (check-in from 15:00, check-out by 11:00, free on-site parking, luggage storage). Cobae cannot eat raw food: sashimi and sushi are for the adults, so every raw-fish meal needs a cooked option for him (noted on each stop).

GETTING AROUND (decision): do not rent for the whole stay. Day 1 follows an overnight flight, and Day 3-4 places are all within a few km of the hotel, so use taxis (Kakao T) there. Regular taxis rarely carry child seats: use a rental or charter that confirms one in writing. The only long trip is Day 2 (1100 Altitude Wetland, snow): either a 1-day rental (needs an International Driving Permit from AA Singapore plus Singapore licence and passport) or a private charter with a child seat. Rough total: taxis plus Day 2 charter about 270,000-340,000 KRW; renting 3-4 days about S$340-540 before fuel and extras. Rentals beat taxis only if you add 2 or more long island outings.

OPTIONAL OUTINGS (need a car or charter): Hello Kitty Island + Camellia Hill (Andeok, indoor backup if the 1100 road is closed), Forest Safari (dinosaur walkway, Jocheon), Eco Land (train, Jocheon). Jeju Dinosaur Land (Aewol) is listed as no longer operating on one site and still sold on another: verify before planning. Snow is a bonus, not the plan; the 1100 and 5.16 roads can close.

days.title: Land after the overnight flight; slow day

stops.title: Land at Jeju Airport; immigration and bags
stops.notes: Fill in the e-Arrival Card beforehand. Buy a T-money card at the airport CU or 7-Eleven. Do not drive today: you will be tired after the 02:30 departure.

stops.title: Transfer to hotel (about 3 km): pre-booked car with child seat, or a Kakao T taxi
stops.notes: Regular taxis rarely have a child seat. A taxi from the airport to central Jeju City is roughly 9,000 KRW.

stops.title: Best Western Jeju Hotel: drop bags and ask for early check-in
stops.notes: Check-in officially from 15:00. 24-hour front desk and luggage storage. Cheju Halla General Hospital is about a 4-6 minute walk.

stops.title: Coffee and pastry: Starbucks in the hotel lobby or Flat 4 Coffee Roasters (about 1 minute walk)
stops.notes: Flat 4 hours not verified.

stops.title: Lunch at Papero (wood-fired pizza and pasta), Nohyeong-dong
stops.notes: Hours not verified: confirm. Backup: Roost Place Nohyeong (tonkatsu to pizza, listed from 9,900 KRW for a medium pizza).

stops.title: E-Mart Sinjeju: water, snacks, diapers, fruit
stops.notes: Listed 0.35 km from the hotel (Trip.com); a guest says within a 5-minute walk. Hours not verified.

stops.title: Check in; nap
Nap (at least 2 hours, until about 17:15)
stops.notes: If the hotel grants early check-in, nap from about 13:30 instead. If not, a stroller or car nap earlier is the fallback.

stops.title: Early dinner at Yunok Nohyeong (ramen)
stops.notes: 11:30-20:00; lines at meal times. Cooked ramen suits Cobae.

stops.title: Back to hotel; early night

days.title: Snow morning at 1100 Altitude Wetland (the only car day)

stops.title: Breakfast at hotel (or Starbucks in the lobby)
stops.notes: One listing shows hotel breakfast at about US$13.88 per person.

stops.title: Pick up car or charter with child seat; drive up the 1100 road
stops.notes: Check road status and the forecast on 26 Dec (Jeju Traffic Information Center). Roads can close and cars may need chains. If closed or no snow, switch to Hello Kitty Island and Camellia Hill (Andeok, indoor), or do Day 3 first. A rental needs an IDP; a Lotte charter lists a child seat at 8,000 KRW per use.

stops.title: 1100 Altitude Wetland: flat 675 m boardwalk in the snow
stops.notes: Free, small free car park. About 6-7 C colder than Jeju City. Best on a clear day 10:00-16:00 after a cold spell. Warm hat, gloves, windproof layer.

stops.title: Sit-down sledding on the natural slope on the way
stops.notes: Sleds for rent at a stand, about 5,000 KRW.

stops.title: Drive back to Jeju City; return the car if renting for one day
Lunch at Susuram (tonkatsu, donburi, karaage), near Jeju City Hall
stops.notes: Cooked Japanese food. Not verified: confirm hours.

stops.title: Nap at hotel (at least 2 hours, until about 16:00)
Bakery cafe break: A La Papa, Yeondong (black milk tea spread, brioche)
stops.notes: Listed 5 minutes by car from Halla Arboretum. Hours not verified. Backup: Cafe Del Moondo (opens 08:00, soft-mat seating upstairs) or Cafe Road near the airport (tent playroom, baby chair).

stops.title: Dinner at Nomore Blues (pizza and pasta), near Jeju City Hall
stops.notes: 11:30-21:30, break 15:00-17:00. Listed as family-friendly. 15 Namgwang-ro.

days.title: Jeju City day by taxi: Halla Arboretum, Sumokwon, Dongmun Market

stops.title: Breakfast at hotel
Taxi to Halla Arboretum (about 2.7 km)
stops.notes: Kakao T or hail one. Taxis rarely carry child seats.

stops.title: Halla Arboretum: easy forest paths, free
stops.notes: Winter hours 09:00-17:00, open every day except Seollal and Chuseok. Free admission, parking, nursing room and diaper-changing table. Allow 1-1.5 hours with a toddler.

stops.title: Sumokwon Theme Park (Yeon-dong): Ice Museum, trick art, 5D theatre
stops.notes: The Ice Museum is kept near -5 C all year, so it is a second chance at ice and an ice slide if the 1100 road had no snow. Bring warm clothes. Hours conflict between sources (09:00-19:00 with last entry 18:00, or longer): confirm. No stroller rental. Some rides may have age limits: check for Cobae.

stops.title: Lunch at Dongmun Fish Market: sashimi for the adults; hotteok at Gate 1 or pasta at Casadidonmun for Cobae
stops.notes: Pick a fish at the market and eat at a restaurant inside. Cobae eats only cooked food: ask for grilled fish, abalone porridge or hotteok. Casadidonmun is a pasta shop in the market's youth mall (hours not verified). The night market near Gate 8 starts after 19:00, probably too late for him. About 6 minutes by car from the hotel.

stops.title: Taxi back to hotel
Nap at hotel (at least 2 hours, until about 16:30)
Yongduam (Dragon Head Rock) sea walk, about 30 minutes
stops.notes: Free, open at all times, about a 10-minute taxi from the airport area. Iho Tewoo Beach (horse lighthouses) is nearby for a short stroll. Skip if windy or he is grumpy after waking.

stops.title: Dinner at Cedars Sushi, Yeondong (sushi set course with udon, steamed egg, tempura)
stops.notes: Cobae eats the cooked parts (udon, egg, tempura). Not verified: confirm hours. Backup: Jaemo Lee Pizza Jeju (Ara-dong, family-friendly, cheese-crust pizza).

stops.title: Back to hotel; pack

days.title: Nohyeong morning, cafe, then the airport

stops.title: Breakfast at hotel
Taxi to Nohyeong Supermarket (89 Nohyeong-ro)
Nohyeong Supermarket: immersive indoor media-art exhibition
stops.notes: It is an art exhibition, not a grocery store. Open 09:00-19:00, last entry 18:00, no re-entry, parking available. Children under 36 months enter free (bring proof of age); strollers have restrictions. A cafe (Nohyeong Dabang) and gift shop are inside.

stops.title: Back to hotel; check out by 11:00; leave bags at the front desk
Lunch at Uratchacha sushibu (conveyor-belt sushi), Halladaehak-ro
stops.notes: 11:30-21:30, closed 15:00-17:00. Listed as family-friendly. Cobae takes cooked items (egg, udon, tempura). Backup: Mikadosushi, City Hall.

stops.title: Souvenirs and snacks at E-Mart Sinjeju (Hallabong and tangerine sweets)
stops.notes: Dongmun Market also sells tangerines and sweets. Keep this day light: snow and wind cancelled 163 of 461 Jeju flights on 8 Feb 2026.

stops.title: Nap (at least 2 hours, until about 15:45): ask the hotel for late check-out or a day room
stops.notes: Check-out is by 11:00, so ask early for late check-out (to about 16:00, may cost extra) or a day-use room. Fallback: leave bags at the front desk and nap in a pre-booked car with child seat parked near Yongduam or the airport, or in a stroller at a floor-seating cafe such as Cafe Road near the airport (tent playroom, baby chair). The airport international terminal has an airside nursing room on the 3rd floor, but that is a last resort.

stops.title: Wake up; coffee and a snack at Flat 4 Coffee Roasters or the hotel lobby Starbucks
Collect bags; transfer to Jeju Airport (pre-booked with child seat, or taxi)
stops.notes: Roughly 9,000 KRW by taxi, 10-20 minutes.

stops.title: Check in, security, immigration
Flight from Jeju to Singapore (arrives 01:15 on 31 Dec)

bookings.notes: Enter carrier, reference, seats and cost.

bookings.title: Best Western Jeju Hotel (27-30 Dec, 3 nights)
bookings.notes: 27 Doryeong-ro, Nohyeong-dong. Check-in from 15:00, check-out by 11:00. Free on-site parking. Enter reference and cost.

bookings.title: Travel insurance, Singlife (27-31 Dec)
bookings.notes: Policy number is not stored in this file because the repo is public: type it into the Reference field in the app.

bookings.title: Day 2 car or charter with child seat (28 Dec)
bookings.notes: Choose: 1-day rental (Lotte Rent-a-Car has an airport desk and English contracts and navigation; Jeju OK Rent-a-Car is another option) or a private charter. Needs an IDP for a rental. Confirm the child seat in writing with Cobae's age, height and weight.

bookings.title: Airport transfers with child seat (27 Dec arrival, 30 Dec departure)
bookings.notes: Optional. Without it, use a regular taxi and hold Cobae.

bookings.title: Sumokwon Theme Park tickets (29 Dec)
bookings.notes: Optional pre-booking on a reseller such as Trazy; check what Cobae can do and the price for his age.

bookings.title: Nohyeong Supermarket tickets (30 Dec)
bookings.notes: Children under 36 months are free (proof of age); adult ticket about US$11 on one listing. Same-day entry is possible.

checklist.text: Enter flight carrier, references, seats and costs for both flights
Decide: 1-day rental or private charter for 28 Dec (taxis cover every other day)
Book the Day 2 car or charter with a child seat; get the seat confirmed in writing
Book airport transfers with a child seat (or decide to use regular taxis)
Nap plan for 30 Dec: ask the hotel for late check-out (to about 16:00) or a day room; if refused, book a car with child seat for a 2-hour car nap before the airport
Message the hotel: early check-in on 27 Dec (arriving about 11:00), cot or extra bedding, luggage storage on 30 Dec
If renting: apply for an International Driving Permit at AA Singapore (about S$20; bring the physical IDP, Singapore licence and passport; online can take up to 10 working days, walk-in is same day)
Confirm the Singapore passport K-ETA exemption covers 27-30 Dec
Fill in the Korea e-Arrival Card (check how early it opens)
Save the Singlife policy number and claims hotline on both phones
Confirm hours and that these are open 27-30 Dec: Papero, Susuram, Cedars Sushi, Casadidonmun, A La Papa, Flat 4 Coffee Roasters, E-Mart Sinjeju
Confirm Sumokwon Theme Park hours and Nohyeong Supermarket hours (sources conflict or are old)
Check snow forecast and 1100 road status; keep Day 2 or swap with Day 3 / Hello Kitty Island
Optional: check whether Jeju Dinosaur Land is open (one listing says no longer operating) and whether 9.81 Park has a Pokemon package
Warm hat, gloves and windproof layer for Cobae; adults too (Sumokwon Ice Museum is about -5 C)
Optional: portable child seat or harness for short taxi rides
Download Naver Map, Kakao Map and Kakao T; get a Korea eSIM
Buy and top up a T-money card at the airport CU or 7-Eleven on arrival
Cooked snacks for Cobae for the sashimi and sushi stops
